flagWhere: event notes: Eudoxus date range and Dedekind influence
fact: Eudoxus lived 408-355 BC per MacTutor, so the shared range of about 370 BC for both roles stands; MacTutor states that Heath equates Eudoxus' equal-ratio definition with Dedekind's while other historians disagree (the dispute is real, unresolved).
note: Read the MacTutor Eudoxus biography for lifespan and the Dedekind discussion.

flagWhere: key_development 876 / event notes: Bakhshali and Sambor dates
fact: Wikipedia reports Bakhshali radiocarbon dates of 224-993 CE in 2017, revised by Oxford in October 2024 to 799-1102 CE; the Sambor inscription dated 605 Saka (683 CE) is called the oldest firmly dated zero as a decimal figure, earlier than the 876 Gwalior inscription.
note: Read raw wikitext of Wikipedia 0 and Bakhshali manuscript; Oxford ORA report is cited there but was not opened.

flagWhere: event notes: Khayyam dates differ between Wikipedia and MacTutor
fact: MacTutor gives Khayyam 18 May 1048 to 4 December 1131, and Wikipedia's infobox also gives 1048-1131, so the 1050-1123 discrepancy no longer stands.
note: Compared MacTutor biography and Wikipedia infobox dates.

flagWhere: event notes: Tartaglia lifespan unsourced (and Descartes 'imaginary')
fact: MacTutor gives Tartaglia born 1499 or 1500 in Brescia, died 13 December 1557 in Venice; separately Wikipedia credits Descartes' La Geometrie (1637) with coining 'imaginary'.
note: Read MacTutor Tartaglia; checked Wikipedia Imaginary number for the Descartes naming claim.

flagWhere: event notes: Pascal Essay pour les coniques 1640 unverified

flagWhere: event notes: Cotes 1714 vs 1722; De Moivre 1722 vs 1730

De Moivre's De sectione anguli is Phil. Trans. 32 (1722) pp. 228-230 in Crossref, but whether it states the explicit formula is unresolved (MacTutor says 1722, Wikipedia cites Miscellanea analytica 1730).
